question: If I cannot put +1/+1 counters on a creature as fabricate resolves, do I still create Servo tokens?

expected.shortAnswer: Yes: you just create the Servo tokens.
expected.answer: If you can't put +1/+1 counters on the creature for any reason as fabricate resolves (for instance, if it's no longer on the battlefield), you just create Servo tokens.
